propositions: Named instances triggering repeated review findings share a root cause of incomplete population enumeration when the author addresses only the specific instance named by the reviewer instead of the entire population.

Existing move 12 (generalize across the work) cannot verify completeness without a machine-checkable acceptance criterion, allowing authors to falsely claim enumeration is complete across multiple passes.
A new coaching move scoped to criteria G1G2, E4, G6, and A1 should reframe named instances as samples from a population and mandate a machine-checkable completeness proof via grep or equivalent.
Move 15 ('sample, not the population') must be added to MOVE_REGISTRY with exact template, applies_when triggers, and mirrored documentation row without modifying any existing move.
